chunks: Ali narrated from his father, from al-Nu'fali, from al-Sakkuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ruled regarding the fetus of al-Hilaliyyah, when she was struck by a stone and expelled what was in her womb, that it is a ghurrah of a male or female slave.

key_terms.الْهِلَالِيَّة: Al-Hilaliyyah (a specific woman mentioned in the narration)
key_terms.غُرَّة: Ghurrah (a specific compensation, defined as the value of a male or female slave)

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money for a fetus killed by a blow to the mother?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain establishes the concept of 'ghurrah' (compensation of a slave's value) for a fetus killed by an external blow, a ruling attributed to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the primary textual evidence for the fixed compensation of a fetus, distinguishing it from the mother's full blood money and highlighting the legal personhood granted to the unborn child in cases of homicide.
